up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1140610. Return their ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, maximum development phases, molecule types, and canonical SMILES strings. Join docs (filter by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140610') to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Output columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140610'
